version.changelog:
Initial release of agent-builder skill.

- Enables end-to-end design and generation of OpenClaw agent workspaces.
- Guides users through key agent setup, including job statement, channels, autonomy, guardrails, and memory options.
- Automatically creates all required OpenClaw files (IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md) with tailored content.
- Supports iteration on existing agents, focusing on addressing failure modes, autonomy adjustments, and safety boundaries.
- Provides checklists for guardrails and fast acceptance test scenarios to validate agent behavior.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agent-builder
Version: 1.0.0

The OpenClaw AgentSkills bundle is designed to help an AI agent build and iterate on other OpenClaw agents' configurations. The `SKILL.md` instructions guide the agent through an interview process and then to generate or modify standard OpenClaw workspace files (`SOUL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, etc.). The included reference files (`references/openclaw-workspace.md`, `references/templates.md`) explicitly promote security best practices, such as not storing secrets in the workspace and including guardrails (e.g., 'ask before destructive actions') in generated agent configurations. There is no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, malicious execution, or any other harmful behavior directed at the executing agent or the user.

llm.summary: This Markdown-only skill helps users build OpenClaw agent workspace files and its sensitive behaviors are disclosed, optional, and aligned with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Requested file creation is proportionate to the stated OpenClaw workspace-building purpose, and the references explicitly warn not to store secrets or credentials in the workspace.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable scripts, package installs, remote downloads, or install-time behavior are present; the package consists of Markdown instructions and references.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger description is somewhat broad for agent design and iteration, but the body narrows the work to OpenClaw workspace generation and targeted diffs, with clarifying questions before autonomy or memory choices.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can generate persistent agent instruction, heartbeat, and optional memory files, but this is the disclosed purpose and includes safeguards such as private-session memory guidance and ask-before-destructive/outbound rules.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes generating and iterating OpenClaw agent workspace documents, including identity, persona, operating rules, user profile, heartbeat, and optional memory files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want help generating or refining OpenClaw agent workspace files. Review any generated MEMORY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, AGENTS.md, and skill roster changes before use, because those files can shape future agent behavior and may persist across sessions.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The activation wording is broad enough to merit caution, but artifact text supports an OpenClaw workspace-building purpose and does not show hidden authority, remote execution, credential use, or unsafe automatic actions.
